answer: No, that isn't legit. Northwind never asks for wire transfers, and if someone calls, texts or emails claiming to be Northwind and asks for a payment or your bank login, you shouldn't respond. Report the message through the Help Center instead. If you really do owe more than our offer (called negative equity), the only payment you ever make to us is that difference, and you make it in person at your appointment after we compare the offer with your payoff letter. We take a cashier's check or a debit card, not personal checks or credit cards. Real offers come only from northwind-auto.example and the Northwind app. Also, you don't have to pay the difference at all: you can keep the car, because an offer never obliges you to sell.
